plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing base phase built around simple bodyweight strength, low-impact power, and a larger conditioning emphasis to match your endurance goal. Week 1 establishes baseline performance on the main strength patterns with hard rep tests so future work can be tracked clearly, and the main training build starts in Week 2.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build aerobic capacity, repeatable work output, and basic full-body strength with simple bodyweight movements and low-impact power.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress conditioning density and single-leg and upper-body strength while keeping movement quality high and fatigue manageable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the base into sharper boxing-specific repeatability, faster bursts, and fresher output without forcing a full speed peak.

exercises.name: 1. Snap Down to Stick
exercises.notes: Drop fast and freeze the landing. Quiet feet and stable trunk.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump to Stick
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the snap down feels too awkward. Land softly and hold each rep.

exercises.name: 2. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Use a strict full range. Stop when body position or range breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one all-out set of strict push-ups. Log your clean reps to establish your starting baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best strict rep set.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use hands on a bench, box, or sturdy surface if floor push-ups are too hard.

exercises.name: 3. Inverted Row from Table or Bar
exercises.notes: Pull chest to the edge or bar. Keep the body straight and pause briefly at the top.

substitutionOptions.name: Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Pull hard against a wrapped towel around a fixed post for 10-20 seconds if no row setup is available.

exercises.name: 4. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Control the descent and keep the front foot flat. Use full range without bouncing.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if split squats bother the knees or balance is poor.

exercises.name: 5. Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, squeeze glutes, and keep the ribs down.

substitutionOptions.name: Hollow Body Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want a harder trunk option without equipment.

exercises.name: 6. Running Aerobic Intervals
exercises.notes: Build an aerobic base without turning this into a race.

endurancePrescription.intensity: Easy to moderate pace, nasal breathing when possible, around RPE 6
endurancePrescription.target: Aerobic base and repeatable movement quality

exercises.name: 1a. Pogo Jumps
exercises.notes: Stay tall and springy. Keep contacts quick and light.

exercises.name: 1b. Shadowboxing Speed Burst
exercises.notes: Short fast combinations with relaxed shoulders. Stop before form gets sloppy.

exercises.name: 2. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a controlled tempo and equal depth on both sides. Stop before balance breaks badly.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one hard set on each leg for as many clean reps as possible. Log reps per side to establish your starting baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best clean rep set on each leg.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you do not have a stable rear-foot-elevated setup.

exercises.name: 3. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve. Keep a straight body line.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Raise the hands if you cannot keep clean reps in the target range.

exercises.name: 4. Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through the whole foot and pause at the top without arching the low back.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stack the body in one line and keep hips high.

exercises.name: 6. Running Continuous Aerobic
exercises.notes: Keep this smooth and conversational. The goal is steady work, not pace chasing.

endurancePrescription.target: General aerobic base and recovery support

exercises.name: 1. Squat Jump

exercises.name: 2. Inverted Row from Table or Bar
exercises.notes: Use strict reps and a full pull. Stop when you cannot reach the same body position.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one all-out strict set. Log your clean reps to establish your pulling baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best strict rep set.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Towel Row Isometric
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you have no safe row setup. Pull hard for a timed effort instead.

exercises.name: 3. Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Step back under control and drive up smoothly from the front leg.

exercises.name: 4. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Lower the head between the hands and keep the elbows under control.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Pike Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the floor version is too difficult.

exercises.name: 5. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Flatten the low back to the floor and keep the ribs tucked.

exercises.name: 6. Boxing Conditioning Circuit
exercises.notes: Keep the work smooth and repeatable. Do not turn the first week into a max-out.
